title: test_question's BUILDME tooth measures its own scratch world: the CodeMother it asks reads the proof's questions store and commons
intention: test_question.py tooth 3 measures the BUILDME entry gate over the scratch world it built. The CodeMother the gate's lanes ask reads the proof's questions store and commons, so an open question closes the answers lane and an answered one lets the crossing through.
why: Measured 2026-11-14 on akiendelllinux (wt-149b at main 64229e33d, and again over 93fa fbca06ff9). Tooth 3 reads red. With the spawned question open, lane the_ticket_has_every_answer_it_needs reads 'none'. Answered, the crossing is refused on buildme_rides_the_outline_check against the LIVE ticket 9adc6fddf185 ('no outline check has run over 9adc6fddf185'). Since 149b9a1ab9c4, transitions._judge asks each lane of a CodeMother that inspect_wire.launch starts, and _gate_in_subprocess bends CAIRN_QUESTIONS_DIR and CAIRN_ARTIFACT_ROOTS only in its own env. ROOT_ENV forwards three roots (berths, tickets_root, crossing_roots) and neither of these, so she reads the live commons. The proof is no longer measuring the gate over its fixture.
traces_to: Law 3 — nothing is known until measured; a proof reading the live commons instead of its fixture measures neither. Law 8 — the tooth must be one a hollow build cannot pass.
how: inspect_wire.launch gains two named roots, questions_root and artifact_roots, mapped in ROOT_ENV to the env names their readers already use (CAIRN_QUESTIONS_DIR for cairn/tools/question/question.py's QUESTIONS_DIR; CAIRN_ARTIFACT_ROOTS for the artifact door's roots) and handed to the CodeMother it launches only when named. test_question.py's _gate_in_subprocess runs its inspect_entry and _entry_gate inside inspect_wire.launch(questions_root=qdir, artifact_roots={...scratch...}). Its fixture writes what all five lanes read in the scratch world: the ticket, its chart claim and berths, its intent and sorted berths, and an outline check record {ran: true} at <commons>/outline_checks/<ticket>-<n>.json. A tooth in test_ask_reaches_a_launched_codemother.py shows the two roots bend when named and stay her own when not.

clauses.claim: with the spawned question open, test_question.py's gate run reads lane the_ticket_has_every_answer_it_needs closing the gate, and the crossing raises naming 'cairn question answer'
once the spawned question is answered, every one of the five BUILDME lanes reads 'none' over the scratch world and _entry_gate raises nothing
inspect_wire.launch hands a named questions_root and artifact_roots to the CodeMother it launches (her question store and artifact roots are the scratch ones), and with neither named her own stand

decisions.text: D1: inspect_wire.launch and _launch_env take questions_root and artifact_roots; ROOT_ENV maps them to CAIRN_QUESTIONS_DIR and CAIRN_ARTIFACT_ROOTS; each is set in her env only when named.
D2: test_question.py's _gate_in_subprocess runs inspect_entry and _entry_gate inside inspect_wire.launch over its scratch questions store and artifact roots; tooth 3 keys clauses 1 and 2 in PROVES.

D3: the fixture (_world) writes what each of the five BUILDME lanes reads: the ticket, its chart claim and berths, its intent and sorted berths, and an outline check record with ran: true. Measure each lane's read before writing its fixture.
D4: a tooth in test_ask_reaches_a_launched_codemother.py, keyed to clause 3: a CodeMother launched with the two roots named reads the scratch ones, and launched without them reads her own.

out: every other component, the inspector included: the lanes' code is unchanged

measured.saw: tooth 3 FAIL: open lane='none' raised=True; answered lane='none' but the_ticket_was_checked_against_the_outline 'closes the gate' with 'no outline check has run over 9adc6fddf185'
measured.how: python3 cairn/tools/question/proofs/test_question.py in ~/dev/src/wt-149b/cairn (93fa over main 64229e33d), the detail line patched for one run to print g_done's raised and lanes, then restored

measured.saw: ROOT_ENV forwards berths, tickets_root and crossing_roots only; question.QUESTIONS_DIR binds from CAIRN_QUESTIONS_DIR at import
